headline: Ferry Logistics and Island Access Reservations
reservation: While mainland parks like East Harbor are open for day use, ferry transport to South Bass and Kelleys Island requires separate ticketing. Peak summer weekends and events like the Biggest Week in American Birding see high demand; check official ferry and lodging sites months in advance for availability.

days.title: Maritime Landmarks

stops.name: Marblehead Lighthouse State Park
stops.detail: Explore the oldest lighthouse on the Great Lakes and its limestone shoreline.

stops.name: East Harbor State Park
stops.detail: Walk the wetlands trail to observe local birdlife or enjoy the sandy beach stretch.

days.note: Arrive at Marblehead early to avoid peak mid-day photography crowds.

days.title: Island Exploration
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Port Clinton Ferry Terminal

stops.name: Perry's Victory and International Peace Memorial
stops.detail: Visit the massive monument on South Bass Island for 360-degree views of the archipelago.

stops.name: South Bass Island State Park
stops.detail: Relax on the pebble beach or hike the white cliffs for a quieter island experience.

days.driving: Walking or local transfer; allow for ferry crossing
days.note: Island travel relies on ferries; check schedules for wind-related cancellations.

days.title: Coastal Nature and Wetlands

stops.name: Magee Marsh Wildlife Area
stops.detail: Walk the famous boardwalk to spot migratory warblers and songbirds.

stops.name: Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge
stops.detail: Drive or hike the scenic loop through diverse wetland habitats.

stops.name: Maritime Museum of Sandusky
stops.detail: Discover the region's naval history and shipwrecks in the revitalized waterfront.

days.note: Spring birding events create high pedestrian traffic on boardwalks.

intel.title: Ferry Terminal Lots
intel.text: Parking at Port Clinton and Sandusky ferry docks can reach capacity by mid-morning. Utilize overflow lots and allow extra time for shuttle transfers during peak summer.

intel.title: Island Connectivity
intel.text: Signal is generally reliable in Put-in-Bay but may drop in the interior of Kelleys Island. Carry physical maps for nature preserves like Old Woman Creek.

intel.title: Mainland Services
intel.text: Refuel in Sandusky or Port Clinton before heading to remote marshlands. Island fuel prices are typically higher and stations are fewer.

intel.title: Birding Seasons
intel.text: April and May are peak for warbler migration, while June–August is best for swimming. Many island attractions operate on seasonal schedules and close for winter.

intel.title: Shoreline Conditions
intel.text: Lake-effect snow can impact winter access to rocky piers. In summer, east winds may affect ferry crossing comfort and schedule stability.

plan.arrival: Rental pickup at Erie International (ERI) is followed by a drive west toward Port Clinton for lodging and ferry access.
plan.vehicle: Cars are essential for mainland nature reserves; golf carts are the standard rental for island transit.
plan.goldenHour: Sunset from the Port Clinton pier; seasonal colors vary with lake humidity.
